scope.method: Read-only cross-check of source code, preregistration/configuration, terminal verdict/decision, and retained metrics through Git objects. TRACE/R2C and simulator-only branches were indexed but excluded as infrastructure rather than detectors.

models.hypothesis: Normal per-PRN nine-tap peak-shape dynamics become jointly surprising during spoofing.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic/cleanDynamic; DS1-DS4
models.physical_observables: prompt-normalized E4..L4 magnitudes and cross-PRN support
models.features: nine tap ratios; GRU next-window standardized residual RMSE; binomial-tail exceedance counts
models.model_structure: shared PRN-local GRU plus causal EWMA binomial-tail gate
models.gate: reported DS1-DS4 onset performance; no later source-distinct gate
models.failure_cause: Strong developmental results were not backed by a source-distinct clean session and later controlled lineage exposed nuisance/provenance limits.

models.hypothesis: A chronologically leakage-controlled B0 residual can support conformal sequential evidence.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic; DS3 available, DS4/DS7-8 unavailable under frozen contract
models.physical_observables: nine-tap prompt-relative magnitude
models.features: GRU residual conformal p-values, e-values, block-max/e-process
models.gate: clean FPR, controls, two core families, linear-AR comparison, source-distinct normal
models.failure_cause: Controls alarmed, only DS3 was available, and source-distinct normal/generalization evidence was absent.

models.hypothesis: A local authentic RF/noise fingerprint trajectory breaks when a spoofer source enters.
models.input_data: TEXBAT DS2/DS3/DS4/DS7 raw IQ with per-recording authentic prefix
models.physical_observables: raw I/Q moments, phase increments, autocorrelation, PSD, amplitude differences
models.features: robust standardized compact raw-IQ texture
models.model_structure: PCA plus linear autoregressive continuity predictor and EWMA
models.gate: exploratory onset metrics; required shortcut ablations not completed
models.failure_cause: Power, AGC, spectrum, quantization, and scenario-construction shortcuts were not isolated; DS3/DS4 had pre-onset/gap alarms.
models.substantive_duplicates: CINDER, NC-TOPI raw-IQ shortcut, BITPROBE RF operator

models.hypothesis: Geometry-conditioned cross-PRN tracking relations deviate under a common spoofing source.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic and DS1-DS4 receiver outputs
models.physical_observables: Doppler geometry, DLL/PLL, complex-tap microstructure, pair relations
models.features: pairwise residual correlations/differences conditioned on LOS, elevation, Doppler, C/N0 and lock
models.model_structure: geometry-conditioned relational neural model with single/multi alarms
models.gate: sealed clean plus DS1-DS4 external score; no terminal GO contract
models.failure_cause: V1 threshold was inflated by PRN-8 reacquisition; V2 reduced that failure but produced weak/inconsistent multi-PRN alarm rates and no validated terminal detector claim.

models.hypothesis: Shared direction in frozen GCMR predictor innovations is specific evidence beyond marginal residual energy.
models.input_data: frozen OAKBAT 3-tap GCMR artifacts; attempted OS1 diagnostic
models.physical_observables: predictor innovations and pair direction
models.features: common/pair innovation scores and relation destruction
models.gate: exact score reproduction before relation destruction
models.failure_cause: Raw residual-to-whitener path did not reproduce R3 scores; cache proxies were scientifically inadmissible.

models.hypothesis: Same-event signed B0 tap innovations share a common drive across PRNs during spoofing.
models.input_data: planned OAKBAT cleanStatic and OS1-OS4 preprocessed nine-tap nodes
models.physical_observables: signed standardized tap prediction innovations
models.features: leave-one-PRN-out median innovation direction, positive alignment, joint evidence
models.model_structure: frozen B0 plus robust relation score and causal EWMA
models.gate: implemented evaluation contract; no committed result artifact
models.failure_cause: No committed execution/verdict exists at the audited base.

models.hypothesis: A domain-adaptive relational transformer over peak-floor features predicts clean temporal structure and exposes spoofing residuals.
models.input_data: configured OAKBAT peak-floor manifests
models.physical_observables: correlator peak/floor complex or magnitude relations
models.features: peak-floor relational tokens
models.gate: implementation tests only; no compact result
models.failure_cause: No committed science result; it also repackages the peak-morphology observable.

models.hypothesis: Conditional predictive or dynamic-innovation dependence among peak-floor coordinates changes under spoofing.
models.input_data: normal peak-floor tables with scoring adapters
models.physical_observables: correlator peak/floor morphology and temporal dependence
models.features: dynamic innovation copula and contrastive predictive residual
models.gate: tests and scorer code only
models.failure_cause: No terminal artifact; physical input is not independent of the audited morphology family.

models.hypothesis: A prompt-normalized local delay-Doppler CAF field admits a compact normal neural field whose residual changes during pull-off.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic; DS3/DS4/DS7/DS8
models.physical_observables: complex local cross-ambiguity function over delay and Doppler
models.features: L20 robust CAF coordinates, dense and actively queried budgets
models.model_structure: normal neural field with context/no-context variants
models.gate: two families, clean/external FPR, active budget, controls, B0 lineage
models.failure_cause: DS4 lacked established pull-off coverage, exact B0 lineage was unavailable, and some aligned scenarios were unavailable.

models.hypothesis: Complex multi-tap temporal structure and sample-dependent active paths outperform magnitude-only B0.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic; DS1-DS3 development, DS7/DS8 post-exposure exploration
models.physical_observables: complex nine-tap morphology and temporal order
models.features: complex/magnitude all9 windows and active query paths
models.model_structure: causal temporal Student-t model with active selector
models.gate: nine criteria covering clean FPR, phase/time destruction, B0, active selection, DS7/8 guard
models.failure_cause: Complex and temporal ablations won only 3/5, active policy had no utility advantage, stable-pre controls failed, and B0 improvement was 0/5.

models.hypothesis: A nuisance-tangent-normal complex nine-tap direction persists by transmitter/PRN origin.
models.input_data: OAKBAT and TEXBAT cleanStatic raw IQ
models.physical_observables: complex nine-tap projective residual direction
models.features: nuisance-normal projective coherence at 1/5/10/30 s lags
models.threshold: AUC identifiability gate, not attack threshold
models.gate: AUC, CI, scalar margin, lag, LOPO, availability and dominance
models.failure_cause: Matched Full AUC was approximately 0.50 in both datasets and lag/LOPO/scalar-margin gates failed.

models.hypothesis: Cross-layer agreement among B0 morphology, raw-IQ continuity, and physics residuals is more robust than marginals.
models.input_data: synthetic clean runs, real TEXBAT/OAK clean and attacks
models.physical_observables: nine-tap residual, raw-IQ texture, prediction residual and concordance
models.features: B0/M1/P3 standardized components and positive co-elevation
models.gate: domain gap, independent clean FPR, alignment destruction, prediction improvement
models.failure_cause: Synthetic calibration transferred with FPR 1.0, real adaptation remained above target FPR, and P3 never improved P1 prediction MSE.

models.hypothesis: Conformal evidence from signed nine-dimensional B0 residuals accumulates across the currently available PRN set.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic, DS1-DS4, DS7/DS8
models.physical_observables: signed nine-tap predictor residual
models.features: Mahalanobis nonconformity, finite-sample conformal p-value, mean negative log p
models.model_structure: shared GRU plus covariance/conformal epoch aggregation
models.gate: clean FPR, DS7/8 stable-pre and detection, B0 improvement, variable cardinality
models.failure_cause: Exact floating timestamps created N=1 pseudo-epochs, invalidating multi-PRN metrics; clean FPR also missed the 1.5% ceiling and B0 improvement failed.

models.hypothesis: At least four clean-conditioned PRNs share a rank-one off-diagonal fourth-cumulant component under a common emitter.
models.input_data: OAKBAT/TEXBAT cleanStatic and static attacks
models.physical_observables: complex residual fourth-order cumulants across PRNs
models.features: rank-one common-origin statistic with nuisance conditioning
models.gate: clean/external FPR, families, ablations, relation destruction, LOPO, shortcuts
models.failure_cause: Clean/external FPR, family recovery, ablation superiority, relation destruction, LOPO and shortcut gates failed.

models.hypothesis: A GPS transmitter retains a chip-synchronous non-Gaussian fourth-cumulant residual after nuisance quotienting.
models.input_data: OAKBAT/TEXBAT cleanStatic raw IQ only
models.physical_observables: fourth-order cyclic cumulants at chip-related lags/cyclic frequencies
models.features: 88-real Hermitian quotient from 30 complex C4 values
models.gate: AUC/CI/worst-seed/baseline-margin/sensitivity/permutation
models.failure_cause: Full-C4 median AUC was 0.537/0.532 with CIs crossing chance and Doppler/CN0 shortcuts stronger.

models.hypothesis: A spoofed signal causes configuration-specific tracking responses that cannot be explained by a shared latent receiver state.
models.input_data: OAK/TEX clean controls through four configurations; exploratory TEXBAT DS3
models.physical_observables: DLL/PLL/FLL/filter/prompt/EPL response under C0-C3
models.features: shared FIR innovations and H0 shared-state versus H1 config-specific RSS gain
models.model_structure: linear predictor, shrinkage covariance, BIC-corrected H0/H1 median pooling
models.gate: clean FPR, physical controls, four-config/four-PRN support, exploratory DS3 gate
models.failure_cause: Phase A became impossible after all 15 OAK negatives failed; locked DS3 established detection was 5.37% and pAUC0.05 0.511.

models.hypothesis: Projective rigidity of complex nine-tap directions loses temporal coherence under overlap attacks.
models.input_data: TEXBAT DS3/DS7 and OAKBAT OS3/OS4 receiver-native TRACE
models.physical_observables: complex nine-tap rank-one projectors and causal differences
models.features: whitened predictor innovation, second-largest PRN, 20 ms blocks
models.model_structure: shared ridge predictor plus shrinkage whitening
models.threshold: clean q99 with three consecutive crossings
models.gate: 3/4 core detections, controls, FPR, ablations, coverage
models.failure_cause: Only OS4 passed rate/delay; DS3 and DS7 lacked persistent projective innovation despite adequate support.

models.hypothesis: Whitened multi-PRN tracking innovations admit a common geometry state during coordinated pull-off.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic, DS3/DS7; DS4/DS8 unavailable
models.physical_observables: complex EPL, DLL/PLL, carrier Doppler, code frequency and satellite geometry
models.features: VAR residuals, H0/H1 shared position/clock/velocity state
models.model_structure: linear VAR plus penalized physical-state smoother
models.gate: source-valid transfer, FPR, controls, B0/A2/A5, relation destruction, shared-state plausibility
models.failure_cause: DS4/DS8 and exact comparators were unavailable; available Full scores also failed every scientific criterion and controls.

models.hypothesis: Spoofing creates differential response between slow and fast DLL/PLL configurations.
models.input_data: TEXBAT DS3/DS7 and OAKBAT OS3/OS4 replays
models.physical_observables: counterfactual loop-state and tap response
models.features: slow-fast paired residual families A0-A5/Full
models.model_structure: robust center plus Ledoit-Wolf covariance and median pooling
models.threshold: domain clean q99, three consecutive 100 ms blocks
models.gate: config collapse, FPR, family detection, Full contribution and controls
models.failure_cause: Full added no benefit in any family, external FPR failed, and required nuisance/pair-destruction controls were unavailable or failed.

models.hypothesis: Complex adjacent CAF minors across 20/100/500 ms expose multi-source mixtures before real attacks.
models.input_data: OAK/TEX clean raw IQ plus 84 controlled clean injections
models.physical_observables: multiscale complex CAF rank/minor structure
models.features: relative squared adjacent complex minors and clean tail surprise
models.model_structure: non-neural multiscale max then median over PRNs
models.gate: strong single/four-PRN detection, controls, destruction, multiscale, shortcuts
models.failure_cause: Strong-injection detection, relation destruction, PRN dominance, multiscale, and RMS/CN0 shortcut gates failed.

models.hypothesis: A dense local CAF two-source model recovers injected secondary paths at single and multi-PRN support.
models.input_data: OAK/TEX clean raw-IQ injections; 72 frozen design cases
models.physical_observables: raw-recorrelated complex CAF, code delay/Doppler, NAV-bit-aligned response
models.features: H0/H1 BIC improvement, oracle recovery, projection and support diagnostics
models.training: clean templates and frozen design grid
models.gate: single physics, multi-PRN recovery, controls, target specificity, dominance
models.failure_cause: Multi-PRN recovery and PRN-dominance gates failed; root-cause correction found no discriminative template/lock explanation and terminated Stage-1.

models.hypothesis: A normalized complex temporal operator innovation contains useful structure beyond low-IQ/scale shortcuts.
models.input_data: TEXBAT development plus DS7/DS8 audit metrics
models.physical_observables: complex I/Q temporal operator and estimated scale
models.features: TOPI/NC-TOPI scores with clamped and shortcut ablations
models.gate: paired low-FPR comparisons, normal support, shortcut dominance
models.failure_cause: Alarm overlap with low-IQ shortcut was near 1, and the independent profile lacked normal support.

models.hypothesis: A physics-guided sparse subset of complex CAF coordinates retains two-source GLRT evidence at low compute.
models.input_data: cleanStatic synthetic bank and TEXBAT DS3/DS4/DS7/DS8-derived campaign
models.physical_observables: dense/sparse complex delay-Doppler CAF
models.features: two-source whitened RSS improvement at selected coordinates
models.model_structure: sparse physical GLRT with learned mask
models.gate: sparse-vs-dense gap, controls, fixed/random masks, FPR, families
models.failure_cause: K9 lagged dense pAUC by 13.4%, beat no fixed9 family, failed controls and worst-FPR gate, and did not beat random/uniform/shuffled masks.

models.hypothesis: A causal common change point in nuisance-projected complex nine-tap innovations marks coordinated spoofing onset.
models.input_data: TEXBAT DS3/DS4/DS7/DS8 and OAKBAT OS1-OS4
models.physical_observables: complex nine-tap innovation after gain/phase/delay/Doppler tangent quotient
models.features: per-PRN Bayes factors over step/ramp/transient bases and common onset scan
models.model_structure: ridge VAR plus causal 10 s generalized likelihood score
models.gate: clean/external FPR, ablations, relation destruction, plausible onset in TEX/OAK
models.failure_cause: No TEXBAT family reproduced plausible onset, only one OAK scenario did, controls alarmed, and relation destruction qualified one family.

models.hypothesis: PRN-conditioned NAV-bit edge residual kernels expose a common transmitter operator distinct from receiver filtering.
models.input_data: OAK/TEX cleanStatic raw IQ and NAV/TRACE alignment only
models.physical_observables: complex NAV-bit flip/no-flip edge impulse response
models.features: cross-PRN kernel coherence, distances, separability and third-order common operator
models.model_structure: non-neural edge estimator with block bootstrap/permutation
models.threshold: preregistered identifiability gates; post-hoc relaxed grid diagnostic
models.gate: support, reproducibility, between-PRN separability, flip specificity, nuisance, synthetic control
models.failure_cause: R0a found a remaining flip-specificity resampling mismatch; all corrected point estimates still failed and R0b found no robust signal even under lenient gates.

models.hypothesis: Partial spoofing can be detected with quantiles over the actual available PRN panel rather than a fixed ten-slot panel.
models.input_data: Tuni2025 Galileo C-1 clean and SS-1; other attacks unopened
models.physical_observables: Galileo E1 per-PRN receiver timeline intended for quantile aggregation
models.features: planned dynamic-panel Q50/Q70/Q90/MAX/MEAN/MULTI-Q
models.threshold: clean thresholds intended; no SS-1 score computed
models.gate: receiver support >=4 PRNs, clean regression, false alarm, local signal, aggregation
models.failure_cause: SS-1 acquired only three PRNs; repair variants were receiver-dependent and the selected variant failed clean regression, so scoring stopped.
models.substantive_duplicates: B0/CMTE PRN-set aggregation only; Galileo data domain differs

models.hypothesis: Fusion of complex taps, loop state, geometry, and graph relations improves early detection.
models.input_data: normal multiview and sealed TEXBAT adapters intended
models.physical_observables: complex taps, loop states, geometry and receiver-local change
models.features: heteroscedastic graph/set representations
models.gate: no committed result artifact
models.failure_cause: No promoted compact science result; the observables were later exercised separately by GCMR/GCSPO/CRISP.

models.hypothesis: Conformal fusion of graph and receiver-local change scores transfers to DS4.
models.input_data: multiview normal artifacts and DS4 local-adaptation experiment
models.physical_observables: same multiview complex-tap/loop/geometry space
models.features: graph/local conformal fusion
models.gate: commit records a DS4 local-adaptation spike, not a terminal detector contract
models.failure_cause: Local adaptation on attack recording is not a leakage-safe independent detector claim and no terminal artifact was promoted.

models.hypothesis: Physical-time-matched tracking features provide a lightweight bridge beyond B0.
models.input_data: TEXBAT pipeline inputs
models.physical_observables: tracking-state/morphology at matched physical time
models.features: implementation-defined B0.5 matched windows
models.gate: tests only
models.failure_cause: No committed artifact/verdict and no independent observable beyond later tracking/morphology families.

models.hypothesis: A graph relational network over tracking observables generalizes from normal to static spoofing.
models.input_data: TEXBAT normal PoC and static attack adapter
models.physical_observables: per-PRN tracking nodes and graph relations
models.features: graph message-passing representation
models.gate: tests only; fuse-safe publisher
models.failure_cause: No promoted terminal artifact; same relational space was later tested by GCMR/GCSPO/CORA.

models.hypothesis: A conditional GRU over integrated tracking features improves normal prediction.
models.input_data: normal tracking feature tables
models.physical_observables: tracking morphology and auxiliary conditions
models.features: integrated causal feature sequence
models.gate: training code only
models.failure_cause: No compact evaluation/verdict and no independent physical observable.

models.hypothesis: A hard multi-PRN quorum over morphology residuals is a useful spoofing gate.
models.input_data: TEXBAT clean and DS4/scenario score tables
models.physical_observables: nine-tap morphology residual and PRN support
models.features: q70 node flags, quorum and persistence
models.gate: historical developmental metrics
models.failure_cause: Heuristic support was replaced by a binomial-tail baseline and retains the same source/generalization limits.

models.hypothesis: Static normalized nine-tap morphology is sufficient for one-class attack detection.
models.input_data: TEXBAT cleanStatic and DS3/DS5 external artifacts
models.physical_observables: static prompt-normalized nine-tap shape
models.features: one-class distances and normalized morphology summaries
models.gate: historical external-validation summaries
models.failure_cause: Later exact-support audits often marked Fixed9 unavailable; static shape is covered more rigorously by B0/CRISP/PG-SCC.
